title: Castes in India & Other Essays
subtitle: Annihilation of Caste, Linguistic States, Southborough Evidence, Federation vs Freedom
description: Contains foundational writings including Castes in India (1916), Annihilation of Caste (1936), Maharashtra as a Linguistic Province, and Southborough Evidence.

title: In the Bombay Legislature & Round Table Conferences
subtitle: Speeches in the Bombay Legislative Council, Simon Commission, and London RTC (1930–1932)
description: Legislative speeches fighting for Mahad water rights, education, labor welfare, and Round Table Conference interventions for fundamental rights.

title: Philosophy of Hinduism & Ancient India
subtitle: Philosophy of Hinduism, Revolution and Counter-Revolution, Buddha or Karl Marx
description: Deep historical and philosophical examination of social reform, ancient Indian counter-revolution, and democratic socialism vs Marxism.

title: Riddles in Hinduism
subtitle: An Exposition to Enlighten the Masses
description: Rigorous textual critique of Vedic, epic, and puranic literature exploring religious contradictions and social justice.

title: Untouchables or The Children of India's Ghetto
subtitle: Essays on Untouchability and Social Tyranny
description: Detailed documentation of civil disabilities, social boycotts, economic exploitation, and caste tyranny across Indian provinces.

title: Babasaheb Ambedkar: Speeches & Statements (1947–1956)
subtitle: Law Minister Speeches and Opposition Parliamentary Debates
description: Parliamentary debates, Cabinet resignations, economic planning interventions, and public addresses in independent India.

title: Who Were the Shudras? & The Untouchables
subtitle: Origin of Caste and Untouchability in Ancient India
description: Masterful historical research analyzing Indo-Aryan society, solar dynasty Kshatriyas, and the origin of untouchability from broken men.

title: Pakistan or The Partition of India
subtitle: Analysis of the Communal Question and Geopolitical Security
description: Definitive geopolitical analysis of the communal question, defense considerations, and boundary commissions.

title: What Congress and Gandhi Have Done to the Untouchables
subtitle: A Plea to the Foreigners & Historical Record
description: Extensively documented critique of paternalism, the Poona Pact fallout, and the battle for autonomous political safeguards.

title: Governor General's Executive Council (1942–1946)
subtitle: Labor Portfolios, River Valley Projects, and Post-War Reconstruction
description: Creation of Damodar Valley Corporation (DVC), Hirakud, Central Waterways commission, 8-hour workday, and maternity benefit legislation.

title: The Buddha and His Dhamma
subtitle: Magnum Opus on Buddhist Philosophy and Ethical Humanism
description: Dr. Ambedkar's monumental retelling of the life of the Buddha, Dhamma vs Adhamma, and the social philosophy of liberty, equality, and fraternity.

title: Ancient Indian Commerce & Academic Dissertations
subtitle: Columbia University and London School of Economics Masterworks
description: Academic treatises including Ancient Indian Commerce (1915), National Dividend of India, and early economic dissertations.

title: Principal Architect of the Constitution of India
subtitle: Constituent Assembly Debates, Drafting Committee Reports, and Final Speeches
description: Comprehensive record of drafting the Indian Constitution, defense of Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, and the historic November 25, 1949 address.

title: The Hindu Code Bill (Part 1)
subtitle: Dr. Ambedkar and the Fight for Women's Legal Rights & Equal Inheritance
description: Legislative battle for codifying Hindu personal law, granting women equal property inheritance, divorce rights, and abolishing polygamy.

title: The Hindu Code Bill (Part 2)
subtitle: Parliamentary Debates, Opposition, and Historic Resignation Statement
description: Continuation of the Hindu Code debates and Dr. Ambedkar's landmark October 10, 1951 resignation statement explaining his departure from the Cabinet.

title: Free India's First Law Minister
subtitle: Speeches, Legislative Drafts, and Legal Opinions
description: Legal drafting, reform of the judiciary, representation of the people bills, and pioneering legal opinions for early Indian republic.

title: Pali Grammar & Linguistics
subtitle: Pali-English Dictionary, Linguistic Studies, and Buddhist Canon Glossaries
description: Scholarly linguistic manuscripts compiling an exhaustive Pali Grammar and Pali-English-Marathi dictionary for Buddhist canonical study.

title: Egalitarian Revolution: Speeches (Part 1)
subtitle: Historic Addresses and Mahad Satyagraha Documents
description: Public speeches, declarations of human rights at Mahad, temple entry struggles, and rallying calls to educate, agitate, and organize.

title: Egalitarian Revolution: Political & Economic (Part 2)
subtitle: Manifestos of the Independent Labour Party & Scheduled Castes Federation
description: Charters of the Independent Labour Party (ILP), agrarian reforms, anti-Khoti agitation, and States and Minorities constitution draft.

title: Egalitarian Revolution: Conversion to Buddhism (Part 3)
subtitle: Historic 1956 Deeksha Bhoomi Nagpur Speeches & Renunciation of Caste
description: Speeches in Rangoon, Kathmandu, and the landmark October 14–15, 1956 addresses administering the 22 Vows to half a million followers.
